text:
Lena: opened a small PR updating SOC 2 wording on audit logs + adding a "copy-and-go" SDK snippet for listing events. Main asks: make the language less prescriptive about retention and ensure snippets are privacy-safe. PR link in thread.

Tom: quick pass: examples still include clear-looking emails. Replace with <redacted_email>. Also, anchors changed recently so links may be broken (use #retention-policy).

Lena: thanks, will scrub. Current draft retention blurb: "Audit logs are retained by default for 365 days; contact your account team for other options." Thoughts?

Raj: Legal: prefer explicit scoping. Suggest: "Hosted customers: audit logs are retained, by default, for 365 days. Dedicated and Private deployments have configurable retention per contract; contact your account team. Logs are encrypted at rest; Private deployments can use customer-managed keys where applicable. Access to audit logs is restricted via RBAC and recorded in access audit trails." Also avoid publishing retention numbers for Dedicated/Private.

Sasha: For the SDK snippet I converted it to a tiny JS sample that shows pagination + redaction:```js
// JS - safe listing example
const events = await redwood.audit.list({ since: '2024-01-01', page_size: 100 });
const safe = events.items.map(e => ({ ...e, user_email: '<redacted_email>' }));
console.log(safe[0]);
```
Added a one-line warning: "Do not log raw audit events in production; redact PII before storage."

Tom: good. Add a Python example for ops folks and show cursor usage so folks don't do unpaged downloads.

Sasha: added Python snippet:```py
# Python - cursor pagination and redact
cursor = None
while True:
    res = client.audit.list(since='2024-01-01', page_size=200, cursor=cursor)
    for e in res.items:
        e['user_email'] = '<redacted_email>'
        print(e['event_type'])
    if not res.next_cursor:
        break
    cursor = res.next_cursor
```

DocsBot: automated: This thread touches SOC 2 retention. Flagging for legal review and localization. Please add @Raj to PR reviewers. Also recommended linking to /docs/security/audit-logs#retention-policy.

Raj: Reviewing now. Micro-edits: change "retained by default for 365 days" -> "retained, by default, for 365 days" for readability. Add sentence: "Audit exports are access-controlled; use least-privileged credentials and rotate keys regularly." Otherwise OK.

Lena: pushed tiny wording and the export access sentence. Fixed anchor to #retention-policy and replaced emails with <redacted_email>. Can Legal/L10n ack?

Tom: LGTM from docs side. Also fixed a broken link to the API reference (should be /docs/api/audit#export).

Raj: Approved. No legal holds. For localization: avoid jurisdiction-specific guarantees; Intl team should review translated copies.

Sasha: I'll open a follow-up to add the snippets to the internal examples repo and include a short test that verifies no PII fields are present in example fixtures.

Lena: merging after Intl review. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
